svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: TMC5160A: SPI application
svg.desc: Schematic of the TMC5160A spi application: the chip with U2 MCU, U3 Power bridge and sense resistors, C1 capacitor 22 nF, C2 capacitor 100 nF, C3 capacitor 2.2 µF, C4 capacitor 2.2 µF, C5 capacitor 470 nF, C6 capacitor 100 nF, C7 capacitor 100 nF, R1 resistor 2.2 Ω, R2 resistor 4.7 kΩ; the MCU wires carry the port hooks GpioGet(InputPin::Diag0), GpioSet(CtrlPin::DrvEnn), Transfer().
svg.text: The TMC5160 on an MCU's SPI bus with the internal clock, DRV_ENN on a GPIO the driver drives through GpioSet() and DIAG0 on an interrupt input. The power bridge (gate, bridge centre and bootstrap pins, eight
MOSFETs and the sense resistors) is wired as in Figure 3.1 of the datasheet and drawn here as one block. Above each MCU wire: the port hook that drives it. Datasheet: 3 Sample Circuits, p. 15.
